integrity: The algebraic arbitrary-dimension proof is written in RESULT.md; exact rational finite-case checks are supplementary. No claim of independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: The result applies to the noiseless infinite-population homogeneous-interaction model, not to stochastic finite-population absorption.
The analytic attracting equilibrium graph and convergence conclusion are local near the interior uniform frequency state.
The closed spectral-gap formulas require a shared strict friendship/enmity threshold above all nonidentical opinion similarities.
The motivating source ancillary supplementary PDF could not be inspected; a related unseen theorem remains an originality risk.
title: Exact Walsh conservation and relaxation laws for multidimensional friend–foe opinion dynamics
